title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: cassette > Yamaha KX-W282 > Monster digital cable > Yamaha RX-530 > Monster digital cable > JVC XL-R5000 > CDR > EAC (offsets set) > CDWav > Flac (level 8)

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy May 2 1970 Harpur College show shines with a monster Other One and Cold Rain & Snow, captured on a decent soundboard outtake that benefits from EQ.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this early‑70 performance – the Other One, Viola Lee Blues, St. Stephen and especially the heartfelt but out‑of‑tune Cold Rain & Snow are repeatedly highlighted as standouts. The recording is a DP‑8 soundboard source; it’s generally clear and benefits from an EQ boost, though the electric set is in mono and occasional tuning hiccups give it a raw edge. Overall the show is considered a must‑listen despite its quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews praise the musical performance and list many standout songs, while noting only moderate recording issues (mono mix, need for EQ, tuning glitches). The strong show quality outweighs technical flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp soundboard source; benefits from a boosted EQ. Electric portion is mono only, and some listeners note tuning noise and occasional distortion when using SRS‑WOW effects.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set moves smoothly through classic early‑70 jams, delivering powerful transitions and a climactic second half that fans describe as transcendent.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Several reviewers cite an out‑of‑tune moment on Cold Rain & Snow, possibly due to a Gibson SG neck issue.
